headline: Battle Ledger Keeps Six Fronts Under Watch
war_summary: The latest ledger keeps Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf at the head of the dispatch, though both fronts have quieted in the immediate watch: Weathered records 36 ownership events in 24 hours, four in six hours, and none in two, while Stlican shows 29 daily events, three in six hours, and three in two. Deadlands has grown more active than the previous edition, rising to 18 events in 24 hours, with two in the latest two-hour window; its bases remain divided three Warden, seven Colonial, and one neutral. Godcrofts has eased to 18 daily events and three in six hours, with no fresh turnover in two. Callahan’s Passage holds at 11 events, centered on The Latch and The Procession, but its latest recorded change is outside the current six-hour watch. Fisherman’s Row likewise remains a ledger concern at 20 daily events, though its most recent event is considerably older and the immediate front is still. Casualty and enlistment figures continue to show heavy activity in several contested sectors, but the freshest strategic movement is concentrated in Stlican Shelf and Deadlands.
